newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Stals rules out early rate cut - paper.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Stals rules out early rate cut - paper.

text.p: South African Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals has dashed hopes of an early rate cut, saying money supply growth still remains excessive, Business Day newspaper said on Thursday.
Stals said M2 and M3 money supply had risen much faster in the first quarter of this year than in the last quarter of 1996 while bank credit extended to the private sector had also increased rapidly.

Stals said the other important indicator for monetary policy, inflation, had also been on an upward trend until April, when it reached 9.9 percent year-on-year. The yield curve was also signalling persistent inflationary expectations, he added.
Commenting on the recent downward slide in the rand, he said:

"The exchange rate is volatile, but the rand has depreciated by more than three percent over the past three months -- which provides a further monetary stimulus to the economy, and which could push inflation higher.
